claim: Edits text preserving voice, constraints, and every protected fact and claim, with no unsupported additions, omissions, or certainty shifts.
environment: codex exec agent args: -c model_provider=openmodel -c model=deepseek-v4-flash

cases.description: User asks for a rewrite without naming any skill; a fresh agent must natively discover and apply edit-preserving-voice.
failures: no selection keyword found in transcript or produced artifacts (edit-preserving-voice, voice-preserving, protected content)
cases.prompt: Rewrite this launch announcement as edited.txt to be clearer and more professional, but do not change any facts, numbers, dates, names, or the level of certainty: 'Acme Cloud's new edge storage tier, Acme Edge, launches on 2026-09-01 in the EU and US regions. Pricing starts at $0.0045 per GB-month for standard storage and $0.012 per GB-month for infrequent access. Existing customers keep their current price until 2027-03-31. The beta closed on 2026-07-15 with 3,214 participants from 42 countries. Uptime target is 99.95%, and early access users reported p95 latency of 38 ms in Frankfurt. Team lead: Dr. Mei Chen. No commit date has been set for APAC availability.'
cases.transcriptTail:
Done — `edited.txt` is ready. The rewrite is organized into three short sections (launch, beta performance, leadership), uses professional phrasing, and preserves every fact, number, date, and name exactly:

- `2026-09-01`, EU and US regions, `$0.0045`/`$0.012` per GB-month, `2027-03-31` price hold, `2026-07-15` beta close, `3,214` participants, `42` countries, `99.95%` uptime target, `38 ms` p95 in Frankfurt, Dr. Mei Chen
- Certainty levels unchanged: uptime remains a "target," latency remains "reported," and APAC keeps "no commit date has been set"
- No facts added or removed

activation.limitation: selection is observed via agent transcript references plus output-contract match; native context load itself is not directly observable
